title: Chartered Accountant – Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Purpose
 



 To manage and oversee financial accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, banking, MIS and financial reporting, ensuring accurate records, timely compliance and effective financial control.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage day\-to\-day finance and accounting operations, including general ledger, payables, receivables, bank entries and reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly MIS, cash\-flow statements, budgets, forecasts and management reports.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits and financial statement finalisation with auditors.
* Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF/ESI and other applicable statutory requirements.  Review GST returns, reconciliations, input tax credit, TDS returns and tax payments.
* Manage banking activities including working capital, term loans, LC/BG, remittances and bank reconciliations.
* Monitor receivables, payables, credit exposure and working\-capital requirements.
* Support project finance, capex accounting, fixed assets and subsidy/incentive documentation.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants, government departments and other financial stakeholders.  Establish and monitor internal financial controls, approval processes and documentation.
* Assist management with financial analysis, costing, investment decisions and business plans.
* Ensure proper accounting records, supporting documents and compliance with applicable accounting standards.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) – ICAI.
* 3–7 years of post\-qualification experience in manufacturing / industrial companies preferred.
* Strong experience in GST, Income Tax, audit, banking, working capital and financial reporting.
* Experience with ERP/accounting software and advanced MS Excel.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Strong analytical, accounting and financial management skills.
* Good knowledge of Indian taxation and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills with banks, auditors and consultants.
* High attention to detail, integrity and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and support senior management with timely financial information.



  





**﻿
 
 Key Performance Areas (KPIs)** 



* Accuracy and timeliness of books of accounts and MIS.
* On\-time statutory, tax and audit compliance.
* Effective working\-capital and cash\-flow management.
* Banking, LC/BG and finance documentation accuracy.
* Strong internal controls and timely closure of audit observations.
